ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms participating modules, interaction cases and the stub-internals flag are declared; it does not run the modules.
offer: Exercise interactions between real modules and assert their shared observable result. Stubbing the internal boundary defeats the purpose of the integration check.

minimal.reason: List the real modules that interact. Without them the check is a unit test, so name each participant.

mid.reason: List the interaction cases and their shared observable result. Untested interactions break silently, so write each case.

maximal.reason: Set stubbing internal contracts to false. A stubbed internal boundary defeats the integration check, so exercise the real module.
